record.scope: These fictional Cedar native-text single-page fixtures only; no real lender, OCR, currency conversion, financial action or universal finance-charge interpretation.
reviewed_meanings: Capital outstanding means principal in the constructed loan fixtures.
Finance charge means interest only in these constructed loan fixtures; real finance charges may include fees.
Outflow is debit and Inflow is credit; signed bank movement is credit minus debit.
A changed or reversed header, missing marker, extra page, missing amount, repeated ID or both populated bank sides requires review.
review_evidence: All 14 rendered pages inspected in a contact sheet; clean loan, changed header and ambiguous bank row inspected at full size.
Literal independent financial truth checked: loan 2437.10, wrong stated total 2487.10, interest difference 25.00, bank closing 913.65.
Reversed-header truth follows its actual printed meanings; ambiguous bank ID/date remain in the withheld-field denominator.
Actual parser, source grounding, all old native cases and actual OCR corpus pass; regression evidence remains a separate required gate.
record.activation: This record reviews mappings only. Activation is governed separately by the validated source-bound receipt and runtime registry.

record.scope: Three fictional one-page native-text EUR loan fixtures with declared decimal-comma amounts.
reviewed_meanings: Capital pendiente is principal and Intereses devengados is accrued interest for these fixtures.
The exact mapping declares decimal comma and period grouping. The printed rows sum to 3300.25 EUR.
The printed 3350.25 EUR total is 50.00 EUR high. The mixed-format row is withheld for review.
review_evidence: Inspected the extracted native text of all three PDFs and checked the amounts against the fixed known answers.
record.activation: A valid source-bound promotion receipt is required separately.

record.scope: Three fictional one-page native-text EUR loan fixtures with dot-decimal amounts.
reviewed_meanings: Tramo is the row identifier, Capital is principal and Intereses is interest in these fixtures.
The printed rows total 3300.00 EUR. A stated 3350.00 EUR total differs by 50.00 EUR.
The changed Principal header is outside the exact mapping and requires review.
review_evidence: Inspected the extracted native text of each one-page PDF and checked the printed values against the fixed ground truth.
record.activation: A valid source-bound promotion receipt is required separately.
